# temps_notification_provider_email (Resource)

An email notification provider: Temps sends alerts through an SMTP server. For transactional email sent by apps, see `temps_email_provider`. Temps never returns the provider's credentials, so changes made to them outside Terraform are not detected. Reading a provider of another kind is an error.

Import with `<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `notification_providers:read`, `notification_providers:create`, `notification_providers:write`, `notification_providers:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_notification_provider_email" "oncall" {
  name         = "On-call mail"
  smtp_host    = "smtp.example.com"
  smtp_port    = 587
  username     = "alerts@example.com"
  password     = var.smtp_password
  from_address = "alerts@example.com"
  from_name    = "Temps"
  to_addresses = ["oncall@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_address` (String) Sender address.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password. Temps never returns it, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `smtp_host` (String) SMTP server host name.
- `smtp_port` (Number) SMTP server port, for example `587`.
- `to_addresses` (List of String) Recipients.
- `username` (String) SMTP user name.

### Optional

- `accept_invalid_certs` (Boolean) Accept a self-signed or otherwise invalid server certificate.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Send notifications through the provider.
- `from_name` (String) Sender name.
- `starttls_required` (Boolean) With `Starttls`, refuse a server that does not offer it.
- `tls_mode` (String) How the connection is encrypted: `Starttls` (default) upgrades a plain connection, `Tls` connects over TLS, `None` does not encrypt. One of `None`, `Starttls`, `Tls`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id>. Temps never returns the password, so set it in configuration again after importing.
terraform import temps_notification_provider_email.oncall 6
```
